finding.claim: build_index_from_tree / build_file_from_blob follow symlinked parent directories when writing checkout files. A tree containing symlink 'Link' and subtree 'link' (case-fold collision) lets a clone write files outside the work tree on case-insensitive filesystems (macOS, Windows).
finding.source: Remote or repository tree supplied to clone/checkout (client.py:1598, client.py:3308, repo.py:1971, worktree.py:841)
finding.sink: index.py:1916 open(target_path,'wb') and index.py:2231-2232 os.path.exists/os.makedirs on dirname

trace.note: iter_tree_contents yields children in name order; 'Link' (0x4C) before 'link' (0x6C)
symlink created at root/Link pointing to attacker target (e.g. /Users/victim/.ssh)
os.path.exists(root/link) follows case-insensitive match to symlink -> True, makedirs skipped
only leaf-level symlink is handled; parent symlinks are not checked
open(root/link/authorized_keys,'wb') writes through the symlinked parent to the attacker-chosen directory

finding.guards_checked: validate_path and element validators (index.py:2019-2100, 2171-2181) only check element names, not case-fold collisions; get_path_element_validator (index.py:2147-2168) defaults to NTFS validator; leaf-symlink replacement (index.py:1904-1910) does not cover parents; no lstat/realpath parent-component check found in checkout path (grep islink/realpath/resolve). Not verified by execution.
